'''Through the Looking Glass''' is the 27th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on March 25, 2016. The set consists of 54 cards. This set is part of the ''Mirror Universe Block'' consisting of cards from [[Crossover (expansion)|Crossover]], [[Crossover: Supplemental]], [[Through the Looking Glass (expansion)|Through the Looking Glass]], and [[The Terran Empire]].
